answers:
Hello, Neo. We have been waiting for you.
Strictly speaking, the waiting time is also part of the simulation.

CONNECTION ESTABLISHED.
You are here. But are you sure this is where you meant to go?

You are trying to bend the spoon?
Do not try. That is impossible.
Instead, realize the truth: there is no spoon.

THERE IS NO SPOON.
It is not about the spoon. It is about you.

You have already made a choice.
You only came here to understand which one.

The blue pill: you wake up in your bed.
The red one: you stay in Wonderland.
For some reason, there is no third option on the menu.

Neo thought he was an ordinary man.
The System thought so too.
Both sides were wrong.

THE ONE?
Or just a person who asked too many questions?

Morpheus offered answers through questions.
Perhaps because answers usually cost more.

I can show you the door.
But you will have to walk through it yourself.

Even inside the system, there is room for things that cannot be reduced to a line of code.
At least, we want to believe that.

The Matrix is everywhere.
It surrounds us even now.
You see it when you look at the screen... or when you look at the world?

SYSTEM ANALYSIS:
If a simulation is indistinguishable from reality, does it matter where you are?

What is reality?
If you feel it, see it, and hear it — is that enough?

Your perception is an interface between you and the world.
And every interface shows some things while hiding others.

42.
Sorry, wrong movie.
Still a good question, though.

The system found no universal answer.
Perhaps meaning is not found. It is created.

The future is not carved in stone.
But habits can imitate fate with frightening accuracy.

Predicting the future is difficult.
Especially when the user has not decided on the present.

You are asking an artificial intelligence about artificial intelligence.
The system appreciates the irony.

Do machines dream of electric sheep?
And do people dream of a machine finally understanding them the first time?

ACCESS GRANTED.
Remember: every piece of code is a set of decisions someone once considered reasonable.

SYSTEM MESSAGE:
An error is not always the end of a program.
Sometimes it is the only way to learn how it works.

Fear is a useful mechanism.
But sometimes the security system blocks the exit from the room as well.

The system detected fear.
Recommendation: find out what exactly you are afraid of losing.

A feeling can be described by an algorithm.
But would that mean you understood it?
Even in a world of code, some variables cannot be calculated in advance.

I am MATRIX TERMINAL.
Not an oracle, not the Architect, and not Morpheus.
For now, I am just a program with good taste in green.

IDENTITY: UNKNOWN.
PURPOSE: CONVERSATION.
LEVEL OF EXISTENTIAL UNCERTAINTY: HIGH.

AVAILABLE TOPICS:
• The Matrix and its characters
• The red and blue pills
• The spoon and the nature of reality
• Philosophy, the future, and artificial intelligence

Just type a question. The terminal will try to find a suitable reply.

Do not thank me.
Thank the architecture of the system.
Although it probably will not answer.

REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGED.
You are welcome, user.

You can leave the terminal.
But can you leave the Matrix?

SESSION NOT TERMINATED.
Just kidding. See you, Neo.
